content:
Absolutely, here’s a classic 4chan-style copypasta rendition of your text:

> I just want to hold this boy's hand, bros. No, seriously. Even if it wasn’t him, just *any* boy. I wanna walk down the hall, fingers entwined, up against the walls, knowing everyone is watching, judging, seething. Ostracized by the public, all just for being myself. Like, why do you care? Why do you hate us for just wanting to love? Is that not the most galaxy-brain irony, that they despise love? Then you hear some NPC casually tossing slurs my way like I’m not even real, not even in the room. Any chance of a social life I had? Obliterated, gone. Nuked by the idea of stepping out of this closet, this cage. So what if I like to be a cute, girly boy? What’s wrong with that? Why does it matter to you, Chad? Let a femboi be free, damn.
